title: Concept: New Relic browser agent key in a response
description: A New Relic browser licence key rendered into the page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The browser key identifies the account to the ingest endpoint, so a third party can post forged browser data into the same account and skew the dashboards the bank alerts on.
applicability: Deployments that render a New Relic browser licence key rendered into the page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The browser key identifies the account to the ingest endpoint, so a third party can post forged browser data into the same account and skew the dashboards the bank alerts on.
